Situation Report 
Chad Humanitarian Response 
1-31 May 2026
Highlights 
● Refugee arrivals from Sudan slow amid border insecurity: By 30 May 2026, a total of
928,818 refugees had arrived from Sudan since April 2023, with Ouaddaï hosting the largest
number.1 Arrivals declined in May, likely due to increased border insecurity, including a 26
May drone strike in Al-Tina.2
● Insecurity and funding shortfalls increase protection risks in Lac: In Lac Province,
non-state armed group (NSAG) attacks on 4 and 6 May triggered new displacements and a
state of emergency. Funding gaps have also forced humanitarian actors to scale back
services, limiting access to sexual and reproductive health (SRH) and protection services. A
security audit across 25 sites revealed that 96% of sites lacked night lighting and 68%
lacked latrines, heightening gender-based violence (GBV) risks.
● Intercommunal tensions restrict access to essential services in Wadi Fira: Tensions
between the Zaghawa and Tama communities persist in Wadi-Fira Province, with clashes in
Birak and Marassabré resulting in casualties. The violence undermines social cohesion,
restricts population movement, and hinders access to SRH and GBV services.
● Senior UNFPA leadership visits Chad: A high-level UNFPA mission visited N’Djamena,
Ouaddaï, and Wadi-Fira to engage with government authorities, assess humanitarian needs,
convene donor meetings, and review ongoing interventions.
● 90% funding gap: As of May 2026, UNFPA has only received 10% of funding it requires for
Chad, severely restricting life-saving SRH and GBV services for vulnerable women and girls.

Case management: UNFPA provided comprehensive psychosocial support and medical care to 
survivors through partners and specialized centres. All survivors received psychosocial support, with 
further medical and legal assistance provided as needed. 
Capacity building: In Ouaddaï province, UNFPA’s implementing partner, CIAUD, trained 45 service 
providers (including 17 women) across the medical, psychosocial, legal, and security sectors on GBV 
case management. 
Women and Girls’ Safe Spaces (WGSS): During the month of May, UNFPA maintained services in 
11 WGSSs across Ouaddaï and Wadi-Fira provinces through its two implementing partners, CIAUD 
and AFJT. Twenty (20) additional safe spaces in Ouaddaï are managed by other organizations under 
tents provided by UNFPA.

Article 5 / A Member of the United Nations against which preventive or enforcement action has been taken by the Security Council may be suspended from the exercise of the rights and privileges of mem- bership by the General Assembly upon the recom- mendation of the Security Council.

Article 6 A Member of the United Nations which has persistently violated the Principles contained in the present Charter may be expelled from the Organization by the General Assembly upon the recommendation of the Security Council.

Accordingly, our respective Governments, through representatives assembled in the city of San Francisco, who have exhibited their full powers found to be in good and due form, have agreed to the present Charter of the United Nations and do hereby establish an international organization to be known as the United Nations.

However, a seedy shift is not limited to Reform, with belief that the Green party is sleazy having roughly doubled from 18% to 35% over the last 21 months, while such a view of the Lib Dems is also up seven points.

World oil demand is on track to fall this year for the first time since 2020, the IEA said in its latest monthly oil market report, as the conflict continues to disrupt production and exports across the Middle East. A recovery had been under way on the strength of last month’s US-Iran memorandum of understanding, the agency said, but it cautioned that renewed escalation could complicate the outlook further. related.excerpt: THE GENEV A CONVENTIONS OF 12 AUGUST 1949 THE GENEV A CONVENTIONS OF 12 AUGUST 1949 ICRC 0173/002 05.2010 10,000 Mission The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is an impartial, neutral and independent organization whose exclusively humanitarian mission is to protect the lives and dignity of victims of armed conflict and other situations of violence and to provide them with assistance. The ICRC also endeavours to prevent suffering by promoting and strengthening humanitarian law and universal humanitarian principles. Established in 1863, the ICRC is at the origin of the Geneva Conventions and the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. It directs and coordinates the international activities conducted by the Movement in armed conflicts and other situations of violence.
